lines.en: Can you retell your favourite folk tale?
lines.vi: Cậu kể lại truyện dân gian cậu thích nhất được không?

lines.en: Sure. Long ago, a poor woodcutter dropped his axe in a river.
lines.vi: Được. Ngày xưa, một người tiều phu nghèo đánh rơi rìu xuống sông.

lines.en: A fairy appeared with a golden axe, but he said it wasn't his.
lines.vi: Một nàng tiên hiện ra với chiếc rìu vàng, nhưng ông nói đó không phải rìu của mình.

lines.en: Yes. So the fairy gave him all three axes.
lines.vi: Đúng. Nên nàng tiên tặng ông cả ba chiếc rìu.

lines.en: What a great story! The moral is to be honest.
lines.vi: Câu chuyện hay quá! Bài học là phải trung thực.

lines.en: Do you know the story of the cunning fox and the crow?
lines.vi: Cậu có biết chuyện con cáo xảo quyệt và con quạ không?

lines.en: Yes! The crow had some cheese, and the fox wanted it.
lines.vi: Có! Con quạ có miếng pho mát, và con cáo muốn lấy nó.

lines.en: The fox said the crow had a beautiful voice.
lines.vi: Con cáo khen con quạ có giọng hát hay.

lines.en: And when the crow sang, the cheese fell!
lines.vi: Và khi con quạ hót, miếng pho mát rơi xuống!

lines.en: The moral is don't trust people who say too many nice things.
lines.vi: Bài học là đừng tin người nói quá nhiều lời ngọt ngào.

text_en: Long ago, King Hung had an adopted son called An Tiem.
An Tiem was hard-working and honest.
One day, he said that his success came from his own hard work, not from the king.
The king was angry, and he sent An Tiem and his wife to a lonely island.
Life on the island was very difficult.
One day, a bird dropped some black seeds on the sand.
An Tiem planted them, and they grew into big green fruit with sweet red insides.
An Tiem and his wife sold the watermelons to passing ships.
When the king heard the story, he invited An Tiem back home.
The moral of the story is that hard work brings success.

options: An Tiem said his success came from his own hard work.
An Tiem lost the king's sword.
questions.answer: An Tiem said his success came from his own hard work.
